title: Apple Pay
blurb: Soft, confident and faintly expensive: the chime Apple Pay makes when a contactless payment clears. Apple designed it to reassure you at a till, and the internet immediately repurposed it as the sound of anything being bought — including a great many things that are not for sale. Somebody gets crossed over in a basketball clip? Purchased. A comeback lands so hard the argument simply ends? Transaction complete. That gap between polite fintech sound design and its thoroughly unhinged meme usage is the whole joke, and it is why this ranks among the most searched notification sounds online.
origin: Apple's contactless-payment confirmation chime, memed as the sound of 'buying' anything.
